title: The filter named the empty corner 🎭

scenes.narration: At 1:26 a.m. a filter gave the empty corner of my room a name.
It was one of those filters that tells you which character you are. I pointed the camera at my face. Then I swung it round, just for a joke.
The corner of the room was empty. The filter scanned it anyway. A little spinning circle. A soft chime.
A label popped up over nothing. Character match. Ninety-eight percent. It named a villain from a horror film.
I laughed. Then the label moved. One step to the left. Toward the bed.
I tried another corner. Match again. Same name. Same percentage. It was in every corner I pointed at.
I turned the filter back on myself. The circle spun for a long time. The chime sounded twice.
The label said, Match found. Ninety-nine percent. And the name it gave me was the same one.
I put the phone down. Behind me, something chimed.
So tell me. Do you delete the filter, or point it at the corner again?
